title: oauth.callback raises keyerror when switching accounts
body:
Environment

Lattice 3.1.6, macOS 15.3, server ap-south-1.

Steps

Steps to reproduce:
* With the log window open, start switching accounts.
* Apply the renamed key from the release notes to the
  settings file.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

Expected

No traceback; switching accounts normally takes a few
seconds.

Actual

A key that was renamed in the settings file is what the
lookup wants. Following the release notes we renamed that
key in the settings file.

Frequency

Reproduces roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:126 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:58 in start
lattice/auth/oauth.py:108 in callback
KeyError: 'state'
